edits.after:
Do not assign a polity from lifespan or chapter alone.

Distinguish a genuinely undated source fact from an unresolved asserted date.
When all supplied evidence, including inherited context, supplies no date-bearing
wording for an attestation, use `undatedSourceAttestation: true` with a
source-specific `event` string of at least 20 characters and no `sourceDate`,
qualitative, Western-date, or unresolved fields. Preserve every fact, stated age,
reckoning, and relative event sequence; an undated age claim may use the same
marker and substantive event in `dateContext`. Age five alone supplies no calendar
year, birth year, or reign-wide activity interval. Do not invent a date, era, or
research hold merely because the source supplies none. This is not an escape
from a genuine source period, date conversion, event-ownership question, or
conflicting witness: preserve supported bounds or an honest unresolved source
date and research hold. All such facts remain subject to independent date audit.
Leave `identityHints.activeDateHints` as `[]` for this undated-only exception
only when the person has at least one attestation, every attestation uses this
marker, and none of that person's claims has date-bearing chronology. An undated
fact beside a dated claim does not qualify; retain all supported chronology.

scope: Forward prompt clarification only. No re-extraction, live source/runtime/state/claim/index/branch changes or model calls. Candidate coverage, factual coverage, ages/relative sequence, date/reception ownership and independent audits remain required. Other existing validator exceptions are not expanded or redefined by this draft.
limitations: Production validators check shape and structural chronology; they cannot certify that source context is genuinely undated. That requires evidence review. In-memory examples exercise exact-master production helper/gate logic only, not a whole packet/extraction or audit approval.
